ResearchProjectDef.label: early narcotics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into crude but practical drug preparations, including laudanum and stimulant-laced tonics, before advancing into refined modern pharmaceuticals.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced painkillers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into high-potency medical drugs like Morphine and Fentanyl, designed to neutralize extreme pain and stabilize wounded colonists in critical conditions.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced stimulants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into powerful amphetamines and cognitive enhancers, such as Desoxyn and Modafinil, to push physical and mental performance beyond human limits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced somnifacients
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into fast-acting sedatives and hypnotics, like Ambien and Restoril, to reliably induce sleep and optimize colonist recovery cycles.

ResearchProjectDef.label: MKultra project
ResearchProjectDef.description: Research into the ultimate tools of psychotropic engineering. Develop irreversible neuro-chemical conditioning techniques for total cognitive subversion and control.
